question: Why is Rear Admiral Grus' cap visor so long?
answer: We go back to the time when he was a kid. Grus was a gloomy kid who always looked down when he walked. This resulted in him bumping into a lot of things. Walls, cows, people, pirates. When he bumped into pirates, he was severely hurt. His mother made him wear a cap with a long visor so he wouldn't bump into what's in front of him anymore. That's why it's long!
name: Polaris
